event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'Let’s toot together!' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p:
The Fedi what? How does the Fediverse work and how to create your first account there? How to use it for your organisation’s outreach? Tobias and Ana will help you and share with you what we,at the Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE), have learned while doing outreach to our community on the Fediverse. This BoF is a place to ask questions such as – where do I start in the Fediverse? What about the metrics? Ask us anything – and do not miss our presentation “Let’s toot together! The Fediverse for outreach for organizations” which will cover the basics.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Crane Hall.
